name: mod-prettyphotoribbon
description: Build scripts for the Pretty PhotoRibbon Joomla module assets

scripts.build:css: sass media/scss/prettyphotoribbon.scss media/css/prettyphotoribbon.css && sass --style=compressed --no-source-map media/scss/prettyphotoribbon.scss media/css/prettyphotoribbon.min.css
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
